comment: Scope is the kernel closure: engine/** minus the peripheral tooling named in kernel-trellis.yaml. sloppinessIndex is not budgeted: its 20 remaining points are the audit's incomplete-graph floor, not kernel debt. Six deliberate dynamic imports (index.js x2, start-world-node.mjs x2, project-index.mjs, and plugin-interface.mjs reaching the plugin tree above engine/) cannot resolve statically, and the Trellis config has no key that declares them. unresolvedImports bounds that floor, so a seventh unresolved import fails the check. erodedCount, duplicationGroups and importCycleGroups are the real gate.
